message:
Dearest Dawn,

From the very beginning, you have been more than a friend; you have been a true best friend to Diane and a valued friend to Chino. You have seen Diane through the changing seasons of her life—from the innocent days of childhood and high school into the complexities of the present.

You were a steadfast anchor during her most difficult times, offering grace through heartbreaks and solace during painful trials. We truly cannot imagine the curtain rising on this 'happy ending' without you there to witness it.

It would mean the world to us to have you stand beside us as one of our Bridesmaids. Your friendship has always been genuine and true, and having you with us will make our celebration even more meaningful.

As this shall be a most intimate gathering of those we hold most dear, a seat has been reserved especially for you at the top of our list. We sincerely hope you shall join us.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr.

With all our love and gratitude,
Diane & Chino

Dear Tita and Tito,

As we begin this new chapter in our lives, we find ourselves reflecting on the people whose guidance, sincerity, and presence have shaped our journey. It would truly be an honor for us to have you stand as our Principal Sponsors on this most special day.

Our wedding will be a most intimate gathering, shared only with those we hold closest to our hearts, and you have always been at the very top of that list. To ensure we can celebrate fully together, we have reserved three seats especially for you, and we would be delighted if you could bring a loved one to join in our joy.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr.

With all our love and gratitude,
Diane & Chino

Dear Berdean,

From the moment we met, you became a cherished friend to both of us. You have witnessed Diane’s journey through every challenge and joy, and you have come to know Chino’s heart—where he comes from and what matters most to him. In your quiet and genuine way, you have listened to our stories without judgment, a gift that we deeply treasure.

It would mean so much to have you stand with us as one of our Groomsmen. Your presence reflects a friendship that has always been steady, sincere, and true.

As our wedding will be an intimate gathering of those we hold most dear, we have reserved a seat especially for you at the top of our list. We sincerely hope you will join us to witness this new beginning.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr.

With all our gratitude,
Diane & Chino

Dear Darryl,

From the very beginning, you have witnessed how our story unfolded and the moments that brought us together. You have been more than just a colleague; you have become like an older brother to Diane and a truly valued friend to Chino. Having you stand beside us as we exchange our vows would make this day truly meaningful.

It would be our great honor to have you as one of our Groomsmen. Your presence reflects a friendship that has always been genuine, steady, and true.

Our wedding will be a most intimate gathering of those we hold closest to our hearts, and you have always been at the top of that list. We have reserved a seat especially for you, and we sincerely hope you will join us.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr.

With all our love and gratitude,
Diane & Chino

Dear Hayllie,

Some people become part of our story long before we understand how important they will be. You are one of them. You were there during the bride’s teenage years, sharing life as it unfolded, offering friendship that remained through time and change.

That bond never faded. It grew quietly and stayed true, and it is something we both value deeply. When we think of the people who have shaped our journey to this day, you are always among them.

As we begin this new chapter together, it would mean so much to have you stand with us as one of our Bridesmaids. Your presence carries history, care, and a connection that cannot be replaced.

We have reserved two seats for you and your beloved, June Lloyd, so you may share this day together with us. Having you close would make this celebration feel complete.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr.

With all our love and gratitude,
Diane & Chino

Dear J-Ann,

It feels like only yesterday when we were all together, sharing laughter and simple moments as co-workers. We never imagined then that love would quietly blossom between the two of us, yet you were there to witness our journey from the very start.

You saw how everything unfolded—from being colleagues to becoming dear friends, and eventually, finding ourselves as partners in life. We will always be grateful for the role you played in our story.

With this gratitude in our hearts, we warmly invite you to stand with us as one of our Bridesmaids. Your presence reflects a friendship that has always been genuine, steady, and true.

Because we want you to feel as comfortable and welcomed as you have always made us feel, we have reserved three seats especially for you and your children. We would be so happy to have you all there with us.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr.

With all our love and gratitude,
Diane & Chino

Dear Tita Jhayne,

Throughout Diane’s life, from childhood into adulthood, you have been her safe haven—the one she could always lean on when the world felt heavy, and whose love and care understood her in ways no one else could. You have also welcomed Chino with open arms, supporting us both as we built our life together.

We truly cannot imagine celebrating this most special day without you by our side. Having you as our Ninang would be a profound blessing, offering us the guidance and wisdom we value so deeply as we start our new chapter.

As our wedding will be an intimate gathering of those we hold most dear, we have reserved a seat especially for you. We sincerely hope you will join us.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr.

With all our gratitude,
Diane & Chino

Dear Lyne,

Being your sister has always been one of the greatest gifts in our lives. Growing up together—sharing laughter, mischief, mistakes, victories, and challenges that only we can truly understand—has shaped our bond and made it unbreakable.

It means the world to us to have you stand with us as a Bridesmaid on our wedding day. We have reserved two seats for you and your beloved, Shean, so you may share this special day together. Having you there will make our celebration feel complete, as this day is about the people who have been at the very heart of our journey.

We cannot wait to celebrate with you and honor the sisterhood we have shared all these years.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr.

With all our love,
Diane & Chino

Tito Noel at Tita Jocelyn,

Mula pa nang isilang si Diane, naging bahagi na kayo ng kanyang buhay. Bilang Ninong sa kanyang binyag, isa kayo sa mga taong nagpakita ng malasakit, pagmamahal, at gabay sa bawat yugto ng kanyang paglaki. Tinanggap niyo rin si Chino nang buong puso, kung kaya't isang malaking kagalakan para sa amin ang anyayahan kayong maging isa sa aming mga Principal Sponsors.

Nais din naming makasama ang iyong minamahal na si Tita Jo. Ang kanyang kabutihan at suporta sa aming dalawa ay tunay naming pinahahalagahan, at hindi namin maisip na wala kayo sa aming espesyal na araw.

Ang aming kasal ay isang maliit at simpleng pagtitipon lamang para sa mga taong pinakamalapit sa aming puso. Kaya naman, nagreserba kami ng dalawang upuan para sa inyong dalawa. Ang inyong presensya ay magsisilbing pagpapala at gabay sa aming bagong pagsasama.

Upang makumpirma po ang inyong pagdalo, inaanyayahan po namin kayong magpadala ng tugon sa pamamagitan ng Facebook Messenger kay Diane Rivera Manalang o Chino Lam Jr.

Lubos po ang aming pasasalamat,
Diane & Chino

Papa,

Sa pagsisimula ng bagong yugto ng aming buhay, ninanais po naming mapalibutan ng mga taong naging gabay, suporta, at sandigan namin—mga taong itinuring na rin naming parang tunay na magulang. At wala pong pag-aalinlangan na isa kayo sa kanila.

Kaya naman, malaking karangalan po para sa amin kung tatanggapin ninyo ang aming taos-pusong hiling na maging isa sa aming mga Ninong sa kasal. Ang inyong pagtanggap ay hindi lamang isang pagpapala, kundi magiging isang mahalagang gabay sa panibagong yugto ng aming pagsasama.

Nais din po namin na makasama ninyo si Mama at si Missy, na kapwa naging malapit at mahalaga na rin sa amin. Kaya naman, naglaan po kami ng tatlong upuan para lamang sa inyo upang inyong masaksihan ang araw na ito na napakaespesyal para sa aming lahat.

Upang makumpirma po ang inyong pagdalo, inaanyayahan po namin kayong magpadala ng tugon sa pamamagitan ng Facebook Messenger kay Diane Rivera Manalang o Chino Lam Jr.

Lubos po ang aming pasasalamat at pagmamahal,
Diane & Chino

Dear Shean,

From the very first time we got to know you, it was clear how much heart and warmth you bring to our family. Your presence, your laughter, and the way you have embraced us all have always stood out, and it is something we truly value.

It would mean so much to have you stand with us as a Groomsman on our wedding day. This celebration is about the people who make our lives brighter, and you are certainly one of them.

We have reserved two seats for you and Lyne so that you may share this special day together with us. Having you there will make the occasion even more meaningful.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We are truly looking forward to celebrating with you.

With love,
Diane & Chino

Dear Unises,

You have become such an important part of our lives, and it would mean so much to us to have you stand with us as a Groomsman on our wedding day. From the moments we’ve shared to the joy you bring to our family, your presence has always mattered deeply to both of us.

We have reserved two seats for you and your beloved, Harleen, so that you may share this special day together. Having you there will make our celebration feel truly complete, surrounded by the people who mean the most to our hearts.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr. We truly look forward to celebrating this day with you.

With love,
Diane & Chino

Dear Mommy Ysabelle,

From the very beginning, you have been more than just a colleague to us; you became our Mommy—someone who guided and looked after us with sincerity, remaining close even beyond the walls of work.

You witnessed where our story began, watching as our ordinary days as co-workers grew into something deeper. We truly believe God placed you in our lives with purpose. As we begin this new chapter, we look to people like you who have shown us what genuine love looks like.

Having you as our Ninang would be a profound blessing and a source of guidance we truly value. It would be an honor to have you as one of our Principal Sponsors.

We have reserved two seats especially for you, as we want you to feel as comfortable and warmly welcomed as you have always made us feel.

We kindly request the favor of a reply via Facebook Messenger to Diane Rivera Manalang or Chino Lam Jr.

With all our love and gratitude,
Chino & Diane
